<description>
Part of #36692. This replaces the field-by-field construction of transaction inputs and outputs in `mempool_tests` with `COutPoint`, `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` constructor calls.

It keeps `CMutableTransaction` as the builder, since a `CTransaction` constructor taking inputs and outputs directly is still under discussion (#36696). If one is added, the `vin`/`vout` lists here can be passed to it directly. Either way, the declarative form makes the constructed transactions easier to read.

This change is test-only and does not change the constructed transactions.

The `mempool_eviction` bench and `rbf_tests` changes from the earlier version of this PR have been dropped, as they conflict with #36521. They can follow once that is resolved.
</description>
